confirmed_facts.claim: Circle Q2 2026 Circle Mint customers initiated USD83.004B in USDC minting and USD86.784B in redemptions; net mint-minus-redemption was -USD3.780B.
Circle H1 2026 Circle Mint customers initiated USD156.543B in minting and USD158.540B in redemptions; net was -USD1.997B.
Circle's 2025 comparatives were Q2 net +USD1.357B and H1 net +USD17.476B.
Circle incurred USD324.6M Q2 and USD655.3M H1 distribution costs under Coinbase agreements; total distribution, transaction and other costs were USD412.470M Q2 and USD819.251M H1.

Circle says Coinbase allocations are based partly on USDC held on Coinbase's platform after issuer retention and partly on broader ecosystem growth after approved third-party participant payments; Circle also says Coinbase and Binance distribution costs depend on their respective platform balances and platform policies.

derived_metrics.metric: Coinbase-agreement distribution cost / Circle total distribution, transaction and other costs
derived_metrics.caveat: Not Coinbase share of USDC balances, all distributor payouts or XRP demand.

inferences.claim: Circle Mint fiat-conversion flows are a more direct measure of primary-market USD/USDC conversion than generic on-chain transfer volume.
inferences.basis: Circle's SEC definition of mint/redeem activity as fiat conversions initiated by Circle Mint customers.

inferences.claim: Coinbase is economically important to Circle's USDC distribution model, and its platform balance and commercial terms affect Circle's costs.
inferences.basis: Circle's disclosed allocation mechanics and Coinbase-agreement distribution costs.

unknowns: Circle Q3 2026 mint/redemption flows and Q3 distribution-cost details are not yet available at this cutoff.
Circle Mint flow data do not capture all secondary-market USDC transactions or all end-user distribution routes.
No direct mapping from Circle Mint fiat conversions to XRPL USDC liquidity, RLUSD substitution or native XRP purchases has been established.
Coinbase's exact numeric share of Circle's average USDC on-platform balances remains undisclosed in the cited filing.

disconfirming_evidence.claim: Q2 and H1 2026 Circle Mint net flows were negative despite higher year-over-year average USDC circulation; gross minting/redemption and supply stock therefore require separate treatment.
Circle explicitly states that changes in interest rates and USDC circulation are complex and highly uncertain; it does not claim a deterministic rate-to-supply relationship.
